conflict: This account changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
createDescription: Create an account that can sign in with email and password.
loginEventsDescription: Review login outcomes and sources for all global accounts.
name: Name
nameEditDescription: This updates the account's global name; existing login records retain the name recorded at the time.
noLoginEvents: No login records match these filters.
passwordLoginUnlockDescription: Clear the password login lock and consecutive failed attempts for “{{name}}”. The account status stays unchanged.
personalLoginEventsDescription: Review login outcomes and sources for your account.
resetDescription: Send a password reset email to this account.
resumeDescription: The account can sign in again after it is resumed.
revokeSessionDescription: This session will end immediately and the user must sign in again.
sessionDescription: Review active sessions across all global accounts. Revoking a session immediately ends that login.
sessionRevokeFailed: Could not revoke the session. Try again.
suspendDescription: Suspending this account ends all its sessions and pauses its access to every organization.
verifiedAtCreation: Email is verified as part of account creation.
